input.query: What is the difference between an AI agent and a chatbot?

actual_outcome.final_answer: A chatbot typically follows predefined rules or scripts to handle simple, repetitive queries. An AI agent uses large language models to understand context, reason through problems, and execute multi-step tasks autonomously. While chatbots are reactive, AI agents can proactively plan and adapt to complex user needs.

input.query: Explain the difference between an AI assistant and a traditional FAQ page.
